mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expense ( member_id, user_card_id, category_id, merchant_id, merchant_name, amount, payment_date, input_type, payment_status, approval_status, transaction_type, region, discount_amount, payment_type, is_interest_free ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userCardId}, #{categoryId}, #{merchantId}, #{merchantName}, #{paymentAmount}, NOW(), 'PAYMENT', 'APPROVED', 'CONFIRMED', #{transactionType}, #{region}, 0, #{paymentType}, #{interestFreeYn} )
mapper.select: SELECT card_id FROM user_card WHERE user_card_id = #{userCardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( member_id, user_card_id, payment_channel, is_recommend_based, expense_id, merchant_id, merchant_name, payment_amount, payment_status, requested_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userCardId}, #{paymentChannel}, #{isRecommendBased}, #{expenseId}, #{merchantId}, #{merchantName}, #{paymentAmount}, #{paymentStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT pw.POINT_WALLET_ID AS pointWalletId, pw.POINT_PROVIDER_ID AS pointProviderId, pp.POINT_PROVIDER_NAME AS providerName, pw.TOTAL_POINT AS totalPoint FROM point_wallet pw JOIN point_provider pp ON pw.point_provider_id = pp.point_provider_id WHERE pw.member_id = #{userId} AND pp.use_yn = 'Y' AND pp.point_provider_type = 'FINANCIAL_POINT' ORDER BY pw.total_point DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE point_wallet SET total_point = total_point + #{savedPoint}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE point_wallet_id = #{pointWalletId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_history ( member_id, point_wallet_id, expense_id, point_type, point_amount, content, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{pointWalletId}, #{expenseId}, 'SAVE', #{savedPoint}, #{content}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT p.payment_id AS paymentId, p.expense_id AS expenseId, cd.card_name AS cardName, p.merchant_name AS merchantName, p.payment_amount AS paymentAmount, p.payment_status AS paymentStatus, COALESCE(SUM(ph.point_amount), 0) AS savedPoint, COALESCE(MAX(pw.total_point), 0) AS totalPoint, DATE_FORMAT(p.completed_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS completedAt FROM payment p JOIN user_card uc ON p.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id JOIN card cd ON uc.card_id = cd.card_id LEFT JOIN point_history ph ON p.expense_id = ph.expense_id AND ph.member_id = p.member_id AND ph.point_type = 'SAVE' LEFT JOIN point_wallet pw ON ph.point_wallet_id = pw.point_wallet_id WHERE p.member_id = #{userId} AND p.payment_id = #{paymentId} GROUP BY p.payment_id, p.expense_id, cd.card_name, p.merchant_name, p.payment_amount, p.payment_status, p.completed_at
